FX-SSUP-001.says: The settings as they start: Color To Suppress blue, Suppression 100. Each pixel's blue is held no higher than the mean of its red and green: pure blue turns black, cyan and magenta keep half their blue, the greys, white, yellow, green, red, skin and the warm tones are untouched; every covering is kept.

FX-SSUP-002.says: Color To Suppress green: green turns black, yellow and cyan keep half their green; blue, magenta, red, the greys and skin are untouched.

FX-SSUP-003.says: Color To Suppress green, Suppression 50: each green half way, in encoded values, between the drawing's and FX-SSUP-002's.

FX-SSUP-004.says: Suppression 0: the drawing exactly as it is.

FX-SSUP-005.says: Color To Suppress picked from a green screen, (40, 180, 60): green leads it, so it is FX-SSUP-002 exactly.

FX-SSUP-006.says: Color To Suppress red: red turns black, yellow and magenta keep half their red; skin and orange, whose red leads, lose some of it.

FX-SSUP-007.says: Color To Suppress #808080, a grey: no channel leads, so green is taken, as Screen Key takes it: FX-SSUP-002 exactly.

FX-SSUP-008.says: FX-SSUP-002 with its colour written in capitals, #00FF00: the same.

FX-SSUP-009.says: Suppression keyed from 0 at frame 0 to 100 at frame 4, linear, green: frame 0 is the drawing, frame 2 is FX-SSUP-003, frame 4 is FX-SSUP-002.

FX-SSUP-010.says: FX-SSUP-002 moved three pixels right: the same, moved.

FX-SSUP-011.says: Suppression 101, above 100. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-SSUP-012.says: Suppression -1, below 0. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-SSUP-013.says: Suppression keyed to 150 at frame 4. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-SSUP-014.says: Color To Suppress written "blue", a name, not #rrggbb. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-SSUP-015.says: Color To Suppress written "#00ff0", one digit short. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.
